description: Create a different silhouette of the SAME tiny low lanceolate-leaf ground clump. Arrange three separated small crowns along the ground, each with three pointed leaves, leaving two narrow open gaps. Match the exact muted sage, slate-green and ivory palette, small native one-pixel edges and upper-left shading of the reference. This remains the same species and size of low plant: no flowers, fern, bush, soil or cast shadow. Transparent32x32 canvas; all opaque art inside x2..29,y15..28; rooted center at16,28. Empty upper half. No scaling, enlarged pixel blocks or blur.
